**Eric Schnitger, Ph.D.**\
Pasadena, CA

### Professional Summary

Researcher, analyst, and operations professional with a Ph.D. in Ethics, 17 years of experience at Apple, and a decade of nonprofit leadership and community organizing. Deep expertise in economic justice, climate policy, and technology ethics, combined with strong technical data skills (Python, SQL, R, Tableau) and demonstrated experience building organizational systems, managing budgets, and translating complex research into actionable insight.

* **Communication:** Academic and Policy Writing · Report Writing · Curriculum Design · Facilitation · Public Speaking · Technical Translation for Non-Technical Audiences
